title: Bioprocess optimization and purification of DLA produced using food and fishery waste
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14806-14821
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08276E, Paper

Chandukishore T., Ashish A. Prabhu, K. Narasimhulu
Engineered Yarrowia lipolytica (YDl-Acs) produced D-lactic acid from renewable wastes. Food waste hydrolysate (Aspergillus terreus) served as carbon source and fish protein hydrolysate as nitrogen. Statistical and ANN-GA optimisation achieved 0.94 (g g−1) DLA yields under optimal conditions.
